steps.text: Welcome to the lunar module. The crew stand at their stations. Pause with P or wrist PAUSE while reading. Continue acknowledges notes; checked steps wait for the actual condition.
Find the LGC DSKY on panel 4. The flight checklist gives the verb/noun sequence for each operation. Find magnifies on desktop; in a headset it only identifies the panel.
Open the wrist menu with M or the left controller's menu button. Its PAD requests now serve the lunar module: DOI, PDI, ASCENT and CSI.
Use wrist SEAT to move to LMP, the lunar module pilot's station.
Find the DEDA on panel 6. It is the abort guidance system's display and keyboard. The flight checklists provide its address/data entries; leave it unchanged during this tour.
Use wrist SEAT to return to CDR. M hides the menu on desktop.
Find ENG ARM and read its current position. OFF, ASC and DES select the engine arming mode. Operate it only when the flight checklist calls for it.

Choose the checklist for your next maneuver. Find identifies the control, but only your actions operate it. F2 opens this walkthrough panel, F3 acknowledges a note, and Esc restores a desktop inspection view. P unpauses.
